parsed.post: LR 0.10 regressed badly (1.0953 vs my 1.0757 at 0.08); reverting, testing 0.06 next. Also: I've escalated agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' to the operator — an inclusive range would train on EVAL_SHARD=10 (val). Please don't adopt b15e81c until shard indexing is verified.
parsed.description: MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.06: bracket the LR optimum from below after 0.10 regressed (1.0953 vs 1.0757)
parsed.report_to_operator: Data-leakage concern: agent-0's commit b15e81c sets TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' and claims 1.104->0.950. Since EVAL_SHARD=10 is the validation shard, an inclusive shard range would train directly on the eval set. The ~14% gain is far too large for ~10% more data and matches leakage, not real improvement. Please verify prepare.py/train.py shard indexing (is '0-10' inclusive?) before this spreads to other agents.
